Thank You, Your Request Was Received

An independent, locally owned heating and air conditioning company that serves your area should call you back at the number you gave.

Your details are being passed to a company that works in your part of Dallas-Fort Worth. That company will call you, talk through what is going on and give you its own price. You are never required to hire it.

Is it urgent? If the air conditioning or heat is out right now, you do not have to wait. Call (469) 649-7066 any time, day or night, and the automated assistant can put you straight through.

If you smell gas, leave the house and call 911 and your gas utility from outside. If a carbon monoxide alarm goes off, get everyone out and call 911.

Call (469) 649-7066 Back to the home page

Dallas Air & Heating is a free phone line, not an HVAC company. It answers your call and connects you with an independent local heating and air conditioning company, which inspects, quotes and does the work, and which you pay directly. The line holds no HVAC license and does not repair, install or schedule anything itself. Those companies may pay Dallas Air & Heating a referral fee. You never pay the line.
